title: Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service Constitution Functions and Powers Amendment Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service Constitution Functions and Powers Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVI OF 2011
ACT XVI OF 2011
SINDH CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE
(CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Sindh
Criminal Prosecution
Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers)
Act, 2009
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IVA,
15th June, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-13/2011, dated 9-6-2011.---The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions
and Powers) (Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 16th May, 2011 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 9th June, 2011 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to
amend the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service
(Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh
Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment)
Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

2. Amendment in section 6 of Sindh Act No.IX of 2010.---In
the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution,
Functions and Powers) Act, 2009, in section 6, for subsection (3), the
following shall be substituted:--
"(3) The Prosecutor General shall hold office for a
period of three years:
Provided that the Government may in appropriate
case extend the term of Prosecutor General for a further period of three years.".
